052public class SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest extends Message {
053
054    /** Milliunits. */
055    public static final List<Integer> SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_UNITS = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(500, 1000, 2000, 5000));
056    /** Milligrams. */
057    public static final List<Integer> SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_CARBS = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(2000, 5000, 10000, 15000));
058
059    private boolean enabled;
060    private int modeRaw;
061    private int incrementUnits;
062    private int incrementCarbs;
063    private int changedFieldsRaw;
064
065    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest() {
066        this.cargo = EMPTY;
067    }
068
069    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(byte[] raw) {
070        parse(raw);
071    }
072
073    /**
074     * Sends the increment's captured cargo verbatim, which applies only the fields that capture
075     * flagged: to reach the increment from an arbitrary pump state use {@link #forChange}.
076     */
077    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, QuickBolusMode mode, QuickBolusIncrement increment) {
078        if (enabled) {
079            Validate.isTrue(!increment.equals(QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED), "cannot specify QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED when enabled");
080        } else {
081            Validate.isTrue(increment.equals(QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED), "must specify QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED when disabled");
082        }
083        this.cargo = buildCargo(enabled, mode.getRaw(), increment.magic);
084        parse(cargo);
085    }
086
087    /** See {@link #SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(boolean, QuickBolusMode, QuickBolusIncrement)}. */
088    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(QuickBolusIncrement increment) {
089        this.cargo = buildCargo(increment.isEnabled(), increment.getMode().getRaw(), increment.magic);
090        parse(cargo);
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * @param incrementUnits milliunits
095     * @param incrementCarbs milligrams
096     * @param changedFieldsRaw bitmask of {@link ChangedField}
097     */
098    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, int incrementUnits, int incrementCarbs, int changedFieldsRaw) {
099        this.cargo = buildCargo(enabled, modeRaw, incrementUnits, incrementCarbs, changedFieldsRaw);
100        parse(cargo);
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * <table border="1">
105     * <caption>Parsed fields for SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest:</caption>
106     * <tr><td><code>enabled</code></td><td><code>raw[0] == 1</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td><code>modeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[1]</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td><code>incrementUnits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 2)</code></td></tr>
109     * <tr><td><code>incrementCarbs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 4)</code></td></tr>
110     * <tr><td><code>changedFieldsRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[6] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
111     * </table>
112     */
113    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
114        raw = this.removeSignedRequestHmacBytes(raw);
115        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
116        this.cargo = raw;
117        this.enabled = raw[0] == 1;
118        this.modeRaw = raw[1];
119        this.incrementUnits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 2);
120        this.incrementCarbs = Bytes.readShort(raw, 4);
121        this.changedFieldsRaw = raw[6] & 0xFF;
122    }
123
124    /**
125     * <table border="1">
126     * <caption>Byte layout for SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest.buildCargo(...):</caption>
127     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
128     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
129     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>(byte) modeRaw</code></td></tr>
130     * </table>
131     */
132    public static byte[] buildCargo(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, byte[] magic) {
133        Validate.isTrue(magic.length == 5);
134        return Bytes.combine(
135                new byte[]{(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)},
136                new byte[]{(byte) modeRaw},
137                magic
138        );
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * <table border="1">
143     * <caption>Byte layout for SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest.buildCargo(...):</caption>
144     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
145     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
146     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>(byte) modeRaw</code></td></tr>
147     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementUnits) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
148     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementUnits) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
149     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementCarbs) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
150     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementCarbs) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
151     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>(byte) changedFieldsRaw</code></td></tr>
152     * </table>
153     */
154    public static byte[] buildCargo(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, int incrementUnits, int incrementCarbs, int changedFieldsRaw) {
155        return Bytes.combine(
156                new byte[]{(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)},
157                new byte[]{(byte) modeRaw},
158                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementUnits),
159                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementCarbs),
160                new byte[]{(byte) changedFieldsRaw}
161        );
162    }
163
164    /**
165     * The request that moves the pump from {@code current} to the given settings, or one with no
166     * changed fields when the pump already matches (which need not be sent).
167     *
168     * @param mode ignored when disabling
169     * @param increment milliunits in UNITS mode, milligrams in CARBS mode; ignored when disabling
170     */
171    public static SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest forChange(PumpGlobalsResponse current, boolean enabled, QuickBolusMode mode, int increment) {
172        int units = current.getQuickBolusIncrementUnits();
173        int carbs = current.getQuickBolusIncrementCarbs();
174        int modeRaw = current.getQuickBolusEntryType();
175        Set<ChangedField> changed = EnumSet.noneOf(ChangedField.class);
176
177        if (current.isQuickBolusEnabled() != enabled) {
178            changed.add(ChangedField.ENABLED);
179        }
180        if (enabled) {
181            if (modeRaw != mode.getRaw()) {
182                changed.add(ChangedField.MODE);
183                modeRaw = mode.getRaw();
184            }
185            if (mode == QuickBolusMode.UNITS) {
186                Validate.isTrue(SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_UNITS.contains(increment), "unsupported quick bolus units increment: %d", increment);
187                if (units != increment) {
188                    changed.add(ChangedField.INCREMENT_UNITS);
189                    units = increment;
190                }
191            } else {
192                Validate.isTrue(SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_CARBS.contains(increment), "unsupported quick bolus carbs increment: %d", increment);
193                if (carbs != increment) {
194                    changed.add(ChangedField.INCREMENT_CARBS);
195                    carbs = increment;
196                }
197            }
198        }
199
200        return new SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(enabled, modeRaw, units, carbs, ChangedField.toBitmask(changed));
201    }
202
203    public static SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest forChange(PumpGlobalsResponse current, QuickBolusIncrement increment) {
204        return forChange(current, increment.isEnabled(), increment.getMode(), increment.getIncrement());
205    }

214    }

248    public enum QuickBolusIncrement {
249        DISABLED(false, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 0, new byte[]{-12,1,-48,7,1}),
250
251        UNITS_0_5(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 500, new byte[]{-12,1,-48,7,1}),
252        UNITS_1_0(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 1000, new byte[]{-24,3,-48,7,4}),
253        UNITS_2_0(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 2000, new byte[]{-48,7,-48,7,4}),
254        UNITS_5_0(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 5000, new byte[]{-120,19,-48,7,4}),
255
256        CARBS_2G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 2000, new byte[]{-120,19,-48,7,8}),
257        CARBS_5G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 5000, new byte[]{-120,19,-120,19,8}),
258        CARBS_10G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 10000, new byte[]{-120,19,16,39,8}),
259        CARBS_15G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 15000, new byte[]{-120,19,-104,58,8}),
260        ;
261
262        private final boolean enabled;
263        private final QuickBolusMode mode;
264        private final int increment;
265        // One captured Tandem app write per increment, not a derivation of it.
266        private final byte[] magic;
267        QuickBolusIncrement(boolean enabled, QuickBolusMode mode, int increment, byte[] magic) {
268            this.enabled = enabled;
269            this.mode = mode;
270            this.increment = increment;
271            this.magic = magic;
272        }
273
274        public QuickBolusMode getMode() {
275            return mode;
276        }
277
278        /** Milliunits in UNITS mode, milligrams in CARBS mode; 0 for DISABLED. */
279        public int getIncrement() {
280            return increment;
281        }
282
283        /** @deprecated a captured cargo tail, not an encoding of this increment. */
284        @Deprecated
285        public byte[] getMagic() {
286            return magic;
287        }
288
289        public boolean isEnabled() {
290            return enabled;
291        }
292
293        public boolean getEnabled() {
294            return enabled;
295        }
296
297        public boolean isEqual(QuickBolusIncrement o) {
298            return this.enabled == o.enabled && this.mode == o.mode && Arrays.equals(this.magic, o.magic);
299        }
300
301        public static QuickBolusIncrement forMagic(byte[] magic) {
302            for (QuickBolusIncrement i : values()) {
303                if (i.enabled && Arrays.equals(i.magic, magic)) return i;
304            }
305            return null;
306        }
307
308        /** @return null when enabled at an increment or mode the pump does not support */
309        public static QuickBolusIncrement forSettings(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, int incrementUnits, int incrementCarbs) {
310            if (!enabled) {
311                return DISABLED;
312            }
313            QuickBolusMode mode = QuickBolusMode.forRaw(modeRaw);
314            if (mode == null) {
315                return null;
316            }
317            int increment = mode == QuickBolusMode.UNITS ? incrementUnits : incrementCarbs;
318            for (QuickBolusIncrement i : values()) {
319                if (i.enabled && i.mode == mode && i.increment == increment) return i;
320            }
321            return null;
322        }
323    }
324
325    public enum ChangedField {
326        ENABLED(0x01),
327        MODE(0x02),
328        INCREMENT_UNITS(0x04),
329        INCREMENT_CARBS(0x08),
330        ;
331
332        private final int mask;
333        ChangedField(int mask) {
334            this.mask = mask;
335        }
336
337        public int getMask() {
338            return mask;
339        }
340
341        public static Set<ChangedField> fromBitmask(int bitmask) {
342            Set<ChangedField> ret = EnumSet.noneOf(ChangedField.class);
343            for (ChangedField f : values()) {
344                if ((bitmask & f.mask) != 0) ret.add(f);
345            }
346            return ret;
347        }
348
349        public static int toBitmask(Set<ChangedField> fields) {
350            int ret = 0;
351            for (ChangedField f : fields) {
352                ret |= f.mask;
353            }
354            return ret;
355        }
356    }

359        UNITS(0),

362        ;

369        public int getRaw() {

373        public static QuickBolusMode forRaw(int raw) {
374            for (QuickBolusMode m : values()) {
375                if (m.raw == raw) return m;
376            }
377            return null;
378        }
379    }
